description: A new healthcare platform for patients, caregivers, clinicians, administrators, and blood donors. It provides role-based dashboards, safe educational symptom guidance, appointments, medication lists and reminders, records and test results, care-team messaging, clinic/user administration, a medicine catalog with demo-only checkout, and blood-donor registration and location/blood-type matching. It supports a sample-data demo mode and a separate production mode. Symptom guidance is educational only, with no automated diagnosis or prescription; clinical guidance must use supplied or approved clinician-reviewed material.
